cause_quote: The commit removed `title=${selfLabel}` from the `sidebar-identity-card__name` span, taking away the browser tooltip that displayed the full account name.
user_saw: Long sidebar identity names were clipped, and hovering over a clipped account name no longer showed it in full.
summary: The fix adds an overflow-aware marquee that reveals full account, agent, and workspace names on hover or keyboard focus.
reasoning: I checked the parent of #148624 and confirmed that the account name was already clipped by CSS and carried the full name in a native tooltip. The removal caused the account hover regression, and the fix also adds a reveal interaction to agent and workspace labels that already clipped long names.
